basic_info.description: Cheerful remodeled 3 bedroom, 1.5 bathroom Edwardian home in a coveted Bernal Heights location convenient to Cortland Avenue. This single-level home flows efficiently with an open concept living dining areas, and remodeled kitchen with breakfast bar. The kitchen opens up to a deck overlooking mature trees and a low maintenance rear yard. Three generously sized bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms complete the living space. Additional features include a laundry area on the lower level, 2 car tandem garage with a widened garage door and extra room for a work space or storage. Excellent Bernal Heights location with a 94 walk score and easy access to restaurants, shopping, schools and transportation.
